checks.name: Muat contoh rute loads current level solution without executing it
Hapus terakhir removes one instruction and rewinds an already stepped board
play-mode selector makes Jalankan step once and sequence mode resumes remaining commands
Pulihkan default restores default level, queue, mode and independent audio settings
valid configuration file imports as preview; Validasi does not apply; Terapkan applies once without running
malformed JSON and unknown-command imports cannot mutate live configuration
oversized import is rejected before replacing preview or applying any state
Simpan konfigurasi downloads actual current JSON, not unapplied editor text
Simpan CLASS_STATE downloads saved draft and anonymous prediction without applying or authorizing
upper-grade example loads real repeat blocks and survives configuration export/import unchanged
Layar penuh attempts the real browser Fullscreen API and can exit or gives F11 fallback
teacher tools make no external requests and cause no browser errors

downloadVerification: Real browser download events and JSON streams; no persistent external destination or upload.
limitations: Headless Chrome with software WebGL; physical TV, projector and fullscreen hardware not tested.
